scientific_question: Does the current deployment-visible signed K1 residual, acted on by the sample-specific detector Gram operator of the frozen 96 direction rows, generate a degree-four Krylov subspace that contains a target-compatible K4-minus-K1 Riesz action?
scope: Post-open CPU-only mechanism-capacity diagnostic on the same 20 frozen PoolFire sentinels. It is not a deployable predictor, a full reconstruction, a resource result, an external test, a curved-ray result, or a real BOST result.

immutable_roster.direction_source: exact frozen v147 target-blind direction table

deployment_visible_state.basis: rebuild the pair-depth direction basis from exact K1 dual, signed exact K1 residual, and reported camera geometry
deployment_visible_state.selected_rows: for each of the 96 frozen direction indices, retain only its target-camera and detector-component plane
deployment_visible_state.row_normalization: divide each selected detector row by its positive Euclidean norm
deployment_visible_state.group_id: reported target-camera slot times two plus detector component; IDs only partition co-permuting blocks
deployment_visible_state.empty_group_rule: groups not represented by the frozen 96 directions are omitted and never synthesized
deployment_visible_state.gram: block-diagonal C C^T, with cross-group entries exactly zero and each nonempty group symmetrized
deployment_visible_state.signed_seed: s_i equals the normalized selected detector row inner product with the signed K1 residual in the same target-camera/component plane

frozen_direction_families.degree_reason: one residual seed plus the three remaining CGLS correction iterations between K1 and K4
frozen_direction_families.raw_action_map: multiply every balanced power elementwise by the positive selected-row norms, then normalize each nonzero column by its positive Euclidean norm
frozen_direction_families.visible_seed_control: the first raw global column; no truth-aware coefficient
frozen_direction_families.global_krylov4: one truth-aware four-coefficient projection onto the four sealed global columns
frozen_direction_families.block_krylov4: one truth-aware four-coefficient projection per nonempty target-camera/component group, zero-filled outside that group
frozen_direction_families.block_column_order: ascending group ID, then power degree zero through three
frozen_direction_families.formal_projection: thin SVD with relative singular-value cutoff 1e-10
frozen_direction_families.independent_projection: symmetric column-Gram eigendecomposition with a fixed floating-point roundoff floor, followed by target-blind reduced-QR reorthogonalization in physical action space

target_space_gate.target: the 96 v143 K4-minus-K1 Riesz-action labels selected by the frozen v147 direction table and normalized by positive Euclidean norm

decision_rule.global_krylov4_passes: HEADROOM_GLOBAL_DETECTOR_KRYLOV4_V148; freeze a tiny observation-only four-coefficient predictor on CPU, but do not claim a deployable algorithm.
decision_rule.global_fails_block_krylov4_passes: HEADROOM_BLOCK_DETECTOR_KRYLOV4_V148; groupwise spectral heterogeneity is required, so freeze a small shared groupwise coefficient predictor on CPU.
decision_rule.both_oracles_fail: FAIL_DETECTOR_KRYLOV_CAPACITY_V148; close the current selected-detector-Gram Krylov representation and do not use a larger model or GPU to rescue it.

authorization_after_decision.headroom_decision: freeze one minimal observation-only coefficient sentinel on CPU before any neural model or GPU request
authorization_after_decision.capacity_failure: change the physical direction family or obtain new physical information; do not increase model size
